params.name: fonts
params.description: Filled with the names of scalable font families matching listType

params.name: listType

sentinelValues.meaning: System fonts -- all system fonts (default when omitted)
Favorite fonts -- may be empty if the user has not added any
Recent fonts -- fonts used during the current 4D session

params.description: Type of font list to return, from the 'Font Type List' theme constants

overloads.semanticRole: Populates fonts with font family names filtered by the requested listType category (system, favorite, or recent).

params.name: fonts
params.description: Filled with the names of all system fonts (font families under Windows, or individual font names under macOS if * is passed)
macOS only: return individual scalable font names (e.g. "Arial bold") instead of font family names; has no effect under Windows, which still returns font families.

overloads.semanticRole: Populates fonts with the complete list of system fonts, and on macOS lets the caller request individual font names instead of font family names via the * flag.

constraints: Only scalable fonts are returned; non-scalable/bitmap fonts are never listed.

Under macOS, if the result of this command is used with ST SET ATTRIBUTES on a multi-style text area, the * parameter must not have been passed (only font family names are supported there); 4D Write Pro areas accept either font or font family names.
